releases.summary: Decision Trace Integrity: recognizes the current verified No-News codes and surfaces stale enrichment/Catalyst Attribution Error as blockers. No scoring or threshold retune; training remains reconciliation-gated.

Decision-order consistency: Decision Trace now uses the same Actionability comparator as the top-opportunity card, includes FORMING origin context, and states the exact Training-block reason. No scoring or threshold retune.

Session-transition integrity: Session Clock now forces an immediate refresh when PRE/RTH/AH changes and keeps Executive Mode fail-closed until a snapshot from the new session arrives. Final-close lock and reconciliation rules remain unchanged; no scoring or threshold retune.

Extended-hours persistence integrity: during AH, EARLY_CONFIRMED now requires at least two distinct central AH buckets plus valid Persistence Slope and Gain Retention; local browser history stays Research Only. Session Clock release identity is now read dynamically from the page. No scoring or threshold retune.

Extended-hours volume integrity: AH confirmation now requires measurable, internally consistent ahVolume data. The UI records After-Hours Volume Participation and Extended-Hours Volume Takeover; missing or contradictory AH volume downgrades EARLY_CONFIRMED to pending. No score or threshold retune.

Hour-to-hour AH volume trajectory: reads central AH volume buckets when available and reports accelerating/decelerating liquidity across AH1→AH4. Descriptive only; no score, Actionability, or threshold retune until multi-session validation.

Session-scoped local temporal memory: local fallback points are restricted to the same ET trading date and the same PRE/RTH/AH session, preventing cross-session contamination at boundaries such as 4:00 AM. Central pipeline persistence remains the only executive authority; no score or threshold retune.

In-page release history: the full TAG500 version ledger is now searchable and visible inside the tool, with current-version highlighting and all historical summaries preserved. UX/auditability improvement only; no scoring, Actionability, or threshold retune.

Live cross-source price consistency: compares current Finviz and Yahoo prices/timestamps for each ticker and exposes diagnostic bands plus divergence in the table and integrity log. Diagnostic only—does not change score/Actionability and does not count as a second source for Final Snapshot Reconciliation.

Qualification Coverage dashboard: measures Sharia VERIFIED coverage, Catalyst Sweep readiness, model-input completeness, early-origin coverage, executable A/B coverage, cross-source coverage, and the dominant qualification blockers. Diagnostic/UX improvement only; no score, Actionability, or threshold retune.

Deterministic Business-Activity Pre-Screen: clear prohibited/conventional-finance activities and ETF/fund instruments are marked EXCLUDED before scoring; Shell/SPAC and ambiguous cases remain UNVERIFIED. Qualification Coverage now reports deterministic exclusions separately. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains required for training truth.
